agenda_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Terry Kistler, Chair
Edward Padgett, Vice Chair  Jenny Jolly, Committee Member
George Borst, Committee Member  Bette Donovan, Committee Member
Scott Snider, Committee Member

  Wednesday, March 18, 2026
  Regular Meeting at 10:00 AM
  La Verne Community Center
  3680 D Street, La Verne, CA 91750
Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City
Clerk’s Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Persons addressing the Senior Advisory Committee shall be limited to 3 minutes unless an extension
of time is granted by the Chair, subject to approval of the Committee Members. When any group of
persons wishes to address the Committee, it shall be proper for the Chair to request that a
spokesperson be chosen to represent the group.

Public comments will be allowed on items on this Agenda at the time each item is considered.

Mission of the Senior Advisory Committee
To plan for coordinated delivery of services to senior citizens to eliminate duplication and conflict of
effort, as well as to inform its seniors of the availability of programs.

CALL TO ORDER AND PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

PRESENTATIONS

1.  None

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

2.  Wednesday, February 18, 2026

DISCUSSION ITEMS

3.
  a. Senior Nutrition Program
  b. Meals on Wheels Program
 AGENDA  Senior Citizen Advisory Committee 3/18/2026  Page 2

  c. Bingo Report
  d. Account Balance Update
  e. Monthly Senior Program Fees
  f. Voting on Vice Chair
  g. Senior Advisory Committee Applications Review
  h. AgingNext
  i. Facilities Report
  j. Upcoming Events

PUBLIC COMMENT
Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject matter jurisdiction
of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda items except as provided by law.

STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION & INFORMATION
Committee members may ask a question for clarification, make a brief announcement, make a brief
report on his/her own activities, request staff to report back at a subsequent meeting concerning any
matter, or take action to direct staff to place a matter of business on a future agenda.

ADJOURNMENT

The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 AM on April, 15, 2026 at the La Verne Community Center.

Posting Statement: A true copy of this Agenda was posted on Wednesday, March 11, 2026,
on the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website
at www.laverneca.gov
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, March 18, 2026

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, March 18, 2026.

  Members present: Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly, Edward
  Padgett.

  Members Absent: George Borst.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Parks & Recreation Director, Armando Cisneros,
  Parks & Recreation Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Parks & Recreation Specialist.

  It was moved by Bette Donovan and seconded by Terry Kistler to approve the
  minutes of Wednesday, February 18, 2026 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 455 meals were served to an average of 22 participants in
  February. Meals have been lowered to 27 meals per day due to budget
  constraints with the YWCA.

  Meals on Wheels: N/A.

4. Bingo Report: N/A.

5. Account Balance: $5,079.43.

6. Senior Program Fees: All program fees are paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: The spring session began on Monday, February 23, 2026.
  Classes are going well. Somes classes may were moved around due to the Senior
  Craft Room Closure.

8. Voting on the Vice Chair: Terry Kistler nominated Scott Snider for Vice Chair and
  voted on by the group. It was approved by all members present.
 9. Senior Advisory Committee Applications Review: Bette Donovan nominated Mary
  Louise Smith. It was moved and seconded by Scott Snider. The votes were 3 yays
  to 2 nays. Mary Louise Smith will be the new Senior Advisory Committee member
  replacing Valarie Ortiz.

10. Aging Next: Total Number of La Verne Residents served for the month of
  January was 12. Total Number of La Verne Residents served for the month
  of February was 3.

  New Business

11. Facilities Report: Yvonne reported the leak in the Senior Craft Room will be
  repaired. Veterans Hall is in good condition. The Aquatic Center is in good
  condition.

12. Upcoming Events

  •  Thursday, March 19th – Excursion: Grove/Farmers Market & Grifith Observatory, 1:00PM-10:00PM.
  •  Friday, March 20th – Senior Seminar: Stop Falling! Home and Safety and Preventing Falls and Injuries,
  Presented by Independence at Home, 10:30AM.
  •  Thursday, April 2nd – Excursion: San Diego SEAL Tour, 9:00AM-7:00PM.
  •  Saturday, April 11th – Craft Fair, 9:00AM-1:00PM.
  •  Monday, April 13th – Movie Matinee: Fried Green Tomatoes, 12:30PM.

  Public Comments: Bette Donovan asked questions about the Craft Fair. The name
  was changed so there won’t be confusion as to only seniors attending. The
  council approved the Parks and Recreation Master Plan. Scott Snider reported the
  Gallery Exhibit at Hillcrest from the Ganesha High School students is very nice.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:50AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, April 15, 2026 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Parks & Recreation Specialist
